title: Aurora Audio
description: A headphone held in 65,000 points dissolves into an aurora whose curtains are the live spectrum of a generative score you can play by hand.

title: Terra Atelier
description: Scroll to throw a stoneware pot: wet clay on a working wheel, three pulls, a kiln firing to 1280°C, then a celadon piece you can turn in your hands.

title: Nova Orbit
description: Fly a full launch profile with the scrollbar: nine engines at dawn, a punch through the cloud deck, max-Q vapour, staging, and an orbital sunrise over a night-side Earth.

title: CIPHER
description: A red-team firm whose whole site is a terminal on a phosphor CRT — anyone can play it: a numbered menu, tappable commands, plain-language questions, a live port-scan demo and a guided tour.

title: Flora Lab
description: Plant five perfume botanicals in a living garden. Each grows its own way, buds open, bees visit, and every flower that opens adds its note to a perfume that names, colours and fills itself.

title: Meridian
description: A mechanical watch with an engraved dial and stitched leather strap lifts apart layer by layer as you scroll, while its blued-steel hands keep time.

title: PULSE
description: A playable 40/20 interval clock: drag the dial to preview WORK and REST, then start, pause or reset rounds as the kinetic type responds.

title: Glacier
description: A spring-water vessel raymarched in raw WebGL, with a refractive surface and pointer ripples, paired with its source and mineral profile.

title: Noctua Observatory
description: Explore a seeded night sky by drag, keyboard or named targets; seven constellations reveal their drawn forms and folklore at the eyepiece.

title: Ember
description: A wood-fired bakery menu beside a living hearth: stoke the illustrated fire and watch its light warm a collection of tonight’s loaves.

title: Vertex
description: Three unbuilt projects draft themselves pen stroke by pen stroke on one blueprint sheet, then dolly into hatched plans and sections. A redline pen lets you mark up the model yourself.

title: LIGATURE
description: A specimen you conduct: pointer and sliders bend weight, optical size, softness and wonk, then the whole sheet (optical-size waterfall, design-space grid, glyph inspector, a magazine spread) re-sets in your instance.

title: BATHYAL
description: One continuous dive from the surface to 6,000 m: scroll works the winch, sunlight dies on schedule, and below it your pointer aims the floodlight at animals that glow at their real depths. Switch it off and make your own light.

title: SUMINAGA
description: Suminagashi you can pull: float each tea's ink on still water, draw it out with a stylus or comb using the exact marbling maths, then lay washi on the basin and keep the mirrored print.

title: VECTOR DRIFT
description: The studio site is the demo cabinet: a 3D neon runner with gates, sweepers and near-miss multipliers, sectors that repaint the night, an attract loop with a local high-score table, and an opt-in synth soundtrack.

title: ORRERY
description: A market research desk built around a brass-core particle orrery: select five asset classes, compare four regimes, and turn volatility into an illustrated stress response.

title: MAISON VELA
description: A couture material room with gathered silk, woven detail and four seasonal dyes. Lift the cloth, change the breeze, or study a finished static drape.

title: KOPPAR
description: A copper roasting bench with tumbling beans, thermal lag and a live roast curve. Hold for heat, hear first crack, then drop the batch and keep its cupping receipt.

title: VOLTAIC
description: A detailed electric motorcycle built from geometry, with a finned battery, belt drive and machined suspension. Configure four finishes and three ride modes, then inspect the engineering.

title: HALFTONE
description: A walnut-and-alloy turntable with four illustrated records and original live synthesis. Drop the needle, bend pitch, change RPM, and shape the sound with volume and tone.

title: PETRICHOR
description: One fragment shader as a whole weather station: raymarched cumulus over Kestrel Flats, a sunset you can scrub to, a storm that builds towers and earns its lightning, and a scent index that peaks when rain first meets dry ground.

title: GRAMMAGE
description: Choose one of four handmade papers, then scroll: the sheet folds into a dart on a linen bench, crease by exact crease, lifts for its wings, and flies down the bench. The flight test reports distance and hang time by weight.

title: UMBRA
description: A live fluid simulation of molten chocolate in a copper vat on marble. Stir it down to 27°C, rewarm it to 31.5, and pour: the bar's gloss, snap and bloom follow the temper you actually reached.

title: PENDULA
description: A walnut-and-brass rotary harmonograph on a gallery floor. Both pendulums swing on working gimbals, and the pen leaves a live, pooling ink rosette. Tune the interval, detune and decay, strike it, look down at the sheet, and keep the étude as a print.

title: SOMNE
description: Berth 14 on the 22:04 sleeper. Rain beads on the glass at Veldt Central, the train brakes onto lamplit platforms, the signal at Larkspur clears, and the moon rides the lake at Mirensee before dawn at the coast. The train runs in real time; your scroll keeps the timetable.

title: The Tideline
description: A complete seven-page restaurant website for a tide-to-table kitchen in a fictional harbor town: a live WebGL shoreline whose water follows the tide gauge, a keyboard-friendly four-step booking flow with realistically uneven availability, a printed daily menu with dietary filters, a private-dining floor plan that redraws to your party, and a dock-to-table story. Built to work like a real client site, not a demo.
